transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I, uh… I came in because flying has gotten really hard for me. Just the thought of getting on an airplane scares me badly. I know it doesn’t really make sense, but my body reacts like the plane is going to fall.
Does this intense fear happen only when you have to fly?
Yes… it’s really about flying. Even thinking about getting on a plane, I know it sounds irrational, but I get this feeling like it’s going to fall.
